title: Tech Note: Sending & Receiving SMS in 4D with Twilio
author: Bryan Yen, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: The core integration approach — calling Twilio's REST API over HTTP Basic auth with 4D's native HTTP Request/HTTP AUTHENTICATE commands, and handling inbound webhooks in On Web Connection — is still exactly how you would integrate Twilio SMS into 4D today; only the PHP-based demo path is a bit dated since 4D's own HTTP commands make PHP unnecessary.
related_updates: 4D's native HTTP Request and HTTP AUTHENTICATE commands are the durable, still-current mechanism for calling any REST API including Twilio; no ORDA/REST-specific replacement was needed here since this was already the 'modern' approach

The PHP + Composer + Twilio PHP Helper Library path shown as an alternative is largely superseded in practice by calling the Twilio REST endpoints directly from 4D, avoiding an external PHP runtime dependency
